vulnerabilities.description: Raptor RDF Syntax Library through 2.0.16: heap-based buffer over-read in the N-Triples parser when a bnode id ends in '.'

analysis.detail: The bundled raptor is built with --enable-parsers="rdfxml" only (engine/external/redland/ExternalProject_raptor.mk), so the vulnerable N-Triples parser is not compiled in. The upstream fix is additionally backported via engine/external/redland/raptor/raptor-backport-unreleased-fixes.patch.1.

vulnerabilities.description: Raptor RDF Syntax Library through 2.0.16: integer underflow when normalizing a URI in raptor_uri_normalize_path(), reported via the Turtle parser

analysis.detail: The upstream fix (return an empty buffer when the path length reaches 0) is backported via engine/external/redland/raptor/raptor-backport-unreleased-fixes.patch.1, and CVE-2024-57823.patch.1 additionally makes the path length sanity checks unconditional. The reported trigger, the Turtle parser, is not compiled in either (--enable-parsers="rdfxml").

vulnerabilities.description: Remote command execution in the 'curl' RUBY GEM <= 0.0.9

analysis.detail: Product name collision: this CVE is about the abandoned Ruby gem named 'curl', not the curl project. The bundled component is curl by the curl project (https://curl.se/).

vulnerabilities.description: graphite2: heap buffer overflow in lz4::decompress

analysis.detail: Fixed upstream in graphite2 1.3.10 (2017); the bundled 1.3.15 contains the fix. Flagged only because of a sloppy NVD version range.

vulnerabilities.description: Double free in OpenJPEG j2k_read_ppm_v3 as bundled by 2015-era PDFium/Chrome

analysis.detail: Fixed upstream in OpenJPEG r2997 (2015). The bundled PDFium is the 7988 snapshot (2026), which has contained the fix for a decade.

vulnerabilities.description: Python: POP3 command injection via user-controlled commands in poplib

analysis.detail: The only shipped user of poplib was the mailmerge mail service component (program/mailmerge.py), which is no longer built or shipped: Collabora Online has no mail merge functionality, and its only consumers were Writer's desktop wizard dialogs and the UNO MailMerge service, which nothing in COOL invokes. poplib itself remains only inside the optional python-core (pyuno packages, excluded from the container unless 'withpython'), reachable solely from user macros, which are disabled by default.

vulnerabilities.description: cairo through 1.18.4: assertion failure in _cairo_ft_unscaled_font_fini (DoS)

analysis.detail: The assertion failure is only known to be reachable through Poppler's cairo-ft usage ('as used in Poppler through 25.08.0'), and Poppler is not bundled - it was removed from this tree (the PDF import filter is PDFium-based, and configure/externals contain no trace of poppler). cairo's only consumer here is vcl, whose cairo-ft font lifecycle has no known path to this assertion. Worst case would be an assertion abort (DoS), as the bundled cairo is built without NDEBUG.

vulnerabilities.description: libtiff: signed integer overflow in putcontig8bitYCbCr44tile leading to heap overflow in YCbCr tile decoding

analysis.detail: The bundled tiff-4.7.2 tarball already contains the upstream fix (libtiff commit 782a11d6, 'prevent integer overflow ... in YCbCr tile decoding functions'): all four affected 'incr' computations are the fixed const tmsize_t form. Verified in the tarball source; the advisory's version range is inaccurate.

vulnerabilities.description: curl: cross-origin Digest auth state leak

analysis.detail: Fixed upstream in curl 8.18.0-8.21.0; the bundled curl is 8.14.1. Eleven curl security fixes are backported in engine/external/curl (the proxy credential, HTTP Negotiate reuse, Digest state and bearer clusters), and some of these CVEs are plausibly among them, but the mapping has not been verified patch by patch. The definitive remediation is bumping curl, which needs the Windows build migrated off curl's winbuild/nmake system (removed upstream in 8.17.0) to CMake. curl is reached through the WebDAV/CMIS UCPs, LanguageTool and the translation service; note that most of these flaws need a proxy, netrc or credential setup that a Collabora Online server does not use.
